# CANIX402 — full agent integration guide

> x402-gated Algorand DeFi opportunities data API (version 0.1.0). Normalized yield data for autonomous agents; USDC micropayments at the gateway; no transaction building.

## Overview

- **Gateway base URL:** `https://canix402-api.compx.io`
- **Documentation site:** https://canix402.compx.io
- **Supported protocols:** Tinyman, Pact, Folks Finance, CompX, Dork.fi
- **Operator:** Neon Forge Ltd
- **Support:** kieran@neonforge.ltd
- **Terms:** https://canix402.compx.io/terms

Opportunity responses are normalized records with fields such as `protocol`, `opportunityType`, `opportunityId`, `assetPair`, `apy`, `apr`, `tvlUsd`, `sourceTimestamp`, and `fetchedAt`. Numeric precision follows the published OpenAPI `x-precision` contract (typically 6 decimal places).

## Machine-readable contracts

| Resource | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Discovery | https://canix402-api.compx.io/discovery |
| OpenAPI | https://canix402-api.compx.io/openapi.json |
| x402 manifest | https://canix402-api.compx.io/.well-known/x402.json |
| MCP server | https://canix402.compx.io/mcp (remote `https://canix402-mcp.compx.io/mcp`, streamable-http) |
| LLM index | https://canix402.compx.io/llms.txt |

Always call the **gateway**, not an internal upstream API. x402 enforcement, `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, and settlement happen at the gateway edge.

### MCP server

Prefer the canix402 MCP for agent hosts (Cursor, Claude Desktop). Endpoint: `https://canix402-mcp.compx.io/mcp` (streamable-http). Metadata: `https://canix402-mcp.compx.io/.well-known/mcp`. Walletless: paid tool preflight returns payment requirements; retry with `paymentSignature`. Tools include `canix_list_opportunities`, `canix_get_positions`, `canix_get_execution_quote`, and free discovery helpers. See https://canix402.compx.io/mcp.

## x402 payment flow

1. **Discover** — `GET https://canix402-api.compx.io/discovery` and `GET https://canix402-api.compx.io/openapi.json` (free).
2. **Preflight** — call a paid route without `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`; expect HTTP **402** with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`.
3. **Sign** — client-side: build a USDC ASA transfer matching the advertised requirement (`scheme`, `network`, `asset`, `payTo`, `maxAmountRequired`). Wallet keys stay on the client.
4. **Retry** — repeat the request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (base64 JSON payload). Success returns **200** and may include `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`.

Default payment context (confirm against live discovery before integrating):

- **Protocol version:** 2
- **Network:** algorand-mainnet
- **USDC asset id:** 31566704
- **Facilitator:** https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz
- **Headers:** PAYMENT-REQUIRED, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, PAYMENT-RESPONSE

Example preflight:

```
curl -s -D - https://canix402-api.compx.io/opportunities -o /dev/null
```

## Endpoint reference

- `GET /health` (Free) — Service health check.
- `GET /metadata` (Free) — Service metadata and policy surface.
- `GET /discovery` (Free) — Machine-readable endpoint catalog for agents.
- `GET /openapi.json` (Free) — OpenAPI contract document.
- `GET /favicon.ico` (Free) — API favicon for directory indexing.
- `GET /favicon.png` (Free) — API favicon image.
- `GET /.well-known/x402` (Free) — x402 discovery fan-out document.
- `GET /.well-known/x402.json` (Free) — x402 discovery manifest for agent and directory indexing.
- `GET /opportunities` (0.01 USDC) — Top 10 aggregated DeFi opportunities ranked by APY. Params: protocol=, limit=, offset=, includeInactive=.
- `GET /protocols/:protocol/opportunities` (0.01 USDC) — Top 25 DeFi opportunities for a single protocol ranked by APY. Params: :protocol, limit=, offset=, includeInactive=.
- `GET /opportunities/search` (0.01 USDC) — Caller-filtered opportunities across supported platforms. Params: platform=, type=, minApy=, maxApy=, minTvlUsd=, limit=, offset=, includeInactive=.
- `GET /opportunities/personalized` (0.05 USDC) — Top opportunities tuned to a wallet's held assets. Params: address=, limit=, offset=, includeInactive=.
- `GET /positions` (0.005 USDC) — Algorand DeFi positions held by a wallet. Params: address=.
- `POST /execution/quotes` (0.1 USDC) — Compile a verified transaction shape into unsigned Algorand transactions.

### Route notes

- `GET /opportunities` — top aggregated opportunities ranked by APY (default limit 10).
- `GET /protocols/:protocol/opportunities` — protocol slug e.g. `tinyman`, `pact`, `folks-finance`, `compx`, `dork-fi`.
- `GET /opportunities/search` — filter by `platform`, `type`, `minApy`, `maxApy`, `minTvlUsd`.
- `GET /opportunities/personalized` — requires `address` (Algorand account); premium price; matches opportunities to wallet-held assets.
- `GET /positions` — requires `address` (Algorand account); returns normalized wallet DeFi positions for exactly 0.005 USDC.

Free routes: `/health`, `/metadata`, `/discovery`, `/openapi.json`, `/.well-known/x402.json`.

## Error catalog

- `MISSING_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE` (HTTP 402) — The paid endpoint was called without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
- `MALFORMED_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE` (HTTP 402) — PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload is malformed.
- `EXPIRED_PAYMENT_PROOF` (HTTP 402) — PAYMENT-SIGNATURE proof has expired.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (HTTP 400) — Request validation failed.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (HTTP 500) — Internal server error.

## Sample responses (trimmed)

### GET /opportunities

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "protocol": "tinyman",
      "opportunityType": "lp",
      "opportunityId": "tinyman:pool:1002541853",
      "assetPair": "ALGO/USDC",
      "apr": 10.512,
      "apy": 12.5,
      "yieldBasis": "apy",
      "tvlUsd": 2450000.5,
      "sourceTimestamp": "2026-07-06T09:00:00.000Z",
      "fetchedAt": "2026-07-06T09:00:00.000Z",
      "notes": "sourceTimestamp reflects fetch time; upstream does not expose a per-row update time."
    },
    {
      "protocol": "folks-finance",
      "opportunityType": "lending",
      "opportunityId": "folks:lending:31566704",
      "assetPair": "USDC",
      "apy": 6.06,
      "yieldBasis": "apy",
      "tvlUsd": 29846.609471,
      "sourceTimestamp": "2026-07-06T08:55:00.000Z",
      "fetchedAt": "2026-07-06T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "limit": 10,
    "offset": 0,
    "includeInactive": false,
    "paymentRequired": true
  }
}
```
